messages:
Anya: Heads-up — design pass for the Usage & Billing dashboard. Primary decision: default view should be Org-level or Project-level when users first land? :thinking:
Sam: I vote org-level for billing admins, project-level for devs. Can we surface a persistent toggle so people don't have to hunt? :thumbsup:
Jamal: Echo org-first. Most customers have finance folks who want org rollups. But the toggle needs to be prominent — people miss it today.
Elena: Wireframes attached (link): https://figma.com/file/xyz — I pushed two patterns: top-level segmented control vs side rail switch. The segmented control keeps charts above the fold.
Maya: Accessibility nit — segmented control must be real buttons with aria-pressed, not just styled tabs. Keyboard focus order matters. Also color contrast on the spend line (currently #7b9fff) is borderline.
Anya: Good call. Also copy question: should the primary header read "Org spend" or "Total organization spend"? Shorter wins for space.
Sam: "Organization spend" reads a bit formal. I like "Total spend" with a small subtitle that clarifies scope (Org / Last 30 days).
Jamal: For token breakdown card — proposal: donut + table below with rows for model, tokens, cost. Hover reveals tokenization sample. Thoughts?
Elena: Donut is nice but watch for small-slice visibility. Consider stacked bar for model mix (gives clearer label alignment). Could make donut accessible by adding numeric callouts in the center for screen readers and an adjacent table.
Maya: If donut stays, add alt text and aria-describedby pointing to the table. Also ensure color palette passes 4.5:1 for text overlays.
Anya: Invoice area: product asked to add quick-download button for last 12 months (CSV + PDF) and an "Email invoices" toggle that pings billing admins. Can we keep that in the right rail?
Sam: Right rail works, but make the primary CTA "Download CSV" — finance teams expect CSV first. Add microcopy: "Includes per-token breakdown and line-item charges."
Jamal: Implementation detail: backend will return per-project shards at /billing/exports?range=12m — make sure we include project_id and model_name fields. Also include a flag for aggregated vs itemized.
Elena: UX copy tweak: change "Estimated spend" to "Projected spend (based on usage patterns)" — adds clarity and reduces support tickets.
Maya: Keyboard nav for charts: let arrows move focus between segments, Enter toggles filter. Add a hidden live region to announce changes for screen reader users.
Anya: Visual hierarchy debate: do we show token breakdown cards as 3 small cards in a row or a single expandable card? Small cards are scannable but eat space on mobile.
Sam: Make it responsive: row of cards on desktop, a stacked accordion on mobile. Use same data, different layout.
Jamal: A/B idea: show toggle default to org for new accounts with >1 project, otherwise show project. We can roll this as a gradual rollout.
Anya: Love that. Add a tooltip to the toggle: "You can change this any time; Admins see org totals by default."
DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: staging rollout for the new toggle UI at 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC.
Elena: Final copy decision from design: header = "Total spend", subtitle = "Organization · Last 30 days". Donut + table for token breakdown, stacked bar fallback for small slices.
Maya: I'll draft the accessibility checklist and paste it here in a follow-up.
Anya: Great — thanks everyone. Next steps: Sam/Eng to prototype segmented control + persistent preference; Elena to update figma; Maya to publish a11y checklist. Ping here when PRs exist. :white_check_mark:
